theorem_title: Fixed affine repetition and conditional prefix-return budget
natural_language_statement: For coprime a,b and a natural-valued sequence with b*y(i+1)=a*y(i) for i<k, b^k divides y(0); if y(0)>0 then b^k<=y(0). For coprime b,b+d and b*x(i+1)=(b+d)*x(i)+c, positive d*x(0)+c bounds b^k. Also2*32^d<27^d*(n+1) implies10*d+27<27*n and d<=(27*n-28)/10. Limitations: The recurrence multiplier is fixed. Changing blocks do not inherit the same budget. The numerical return theorem requires its exponential premise; it does not formalize the complete Thue-Morse application.
